boundary: Pass 6000 computes the W(5,2) design exhaustively. The stabiliser order 5040 is INFERRED from |Sp(6,2)|/288 assuming transitivity, which is NOT verified here. The 3-(63,7,2) design is very likely classical and no novelty is claimed

pass_6001_the_7_equals_7_is_dead.note: thirteenth coincidence killed this session, and the first killed by construction rather than by argument
pass_6001_the_7_equals_7_is_dead.test: run the identical heptad program on both and compare the structures
pass_6001_the_7_equals_7_is_dead.verdict: NOT THE SAME OBJECT. Different counts (2880 vs 288), different design strength (2-design vs 3-design), and vastly different stabilisers. The 7 is the only thing they share, and it is a coincidence -- now tested rather than assumed

pass_6002_the_5040.also: 5040 is simultaneously the triple count of the design, which is arithmetic rather than meaningful
pass_6002_the_5040.contrast_with_q3: at W(3,3) the stabiliser is C3 x C6 of order 18 acting with orbits 1+3+3, which is very far from the full S_7. So the two 7-sets sit in their spaces in completely different ways
pass_6002_the_5040.if_transitive: the stabiliser of a 7-set would have order 5040, meaning Sp(6,2) induces the FULL symmetric group on each maximum partial ovoid -- every permutation of the seven points is realised
pass_6002_the_5040.not_verified: transitivity of Sp(6,2) on the 288 sets is NOT computed here; 5040 is what the stabiliser would be IF the action is transitive
